headline: BLS Polymers closes at 155x with GMP 41% but retail odds are ~1 in 79; SFC closes with GMP fading to 4.7%

sfc-environmental-technologies.category_note: Closes today. GMP falling since 22 Oct (peak ₹32, now ₹15.5, 4.7%). Retail 1.72x, ~1 in 2 odds. Apply 1 lot only if you'd hold if listing is flat.

bls-polymers.category_note: Closes today, 155x overall. GMP rising to ₹62 (41%), but retail odds only ~1 in 79: apply 1 lot per family PAN, expect no allotment.

m-k-sons-fine-jewels.category_note: Closes 30 Oct. Retail 0.48x, GMP ₹11 (6.8%) off its ₹15 peak. Weak anchors; recheck on 30 Oct before applying.

bombay-coated-and-special-steels.category_note: Day 1, retail 0.74x, full allotment for now. GMP ₹9 (11%) steady; recheck on 2 Nov close.
